newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi average T-Bill rate falls to 18.33 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malawi average T-Bill rate falls to 18.33 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury Bills fell to 18.33 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 18.97 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Wednesday.
Applications for $9,126-million (Malawi Kwacha 136,900 million) of bills on offer totalled $2,200 million (MK33,000 million). The average price was $6.368 (MK95.512) percent.

The average rate for six-month bills was 18.35 percent from 18.55 percent. Applications for the $15,533-million (MK233,000 million) of bills on offer totalled $5,133 million (MK77,000 million). The average price was $6.080 (MK91.199) percent.
